name: Backend Service
description: The authoritative backend.py entry point starts tray or headless operation, while versioned UDP RPC and MotorService manage ownership, asynchronous runs, feedback, and watchdog shutdown using APS by default or explicitly injected legacy controllers.

name: Hardware And Shared Control
description: ADLINK APS bindings own PCIe-8332 motion and endpoint protection, while shared hardware-independent device types, locking, validation, and motion queues support both current and legacy controllers.

name: Portable UDP Client
description: The independent UdpControl package supplies the standard-library SDK, JSON codecs, protocol version, Tk debug panel, GUI entry point, and command-line motion example without hardware imports.

name: Legacy Direct EtherCAT
description: Retained pysoem direct-NIC controllers, continuous local sessions, CLI, and app.py Tk frontend implement discovery and CiA402 motion alongside the older three-axis bridge host.

name: Legacy Unreal Integration
description: The Unreal Blueprint component and Python demo stream motor-angle targets through the retained three-axis bridge protocol, which is incompatible with the current versioned UDP RPC backend.

name: Regression Tests
description: Fake-hardware, GUI, protocol, deployment-isolation, and loopback UDP regressions verify APS and legacy motion, ordering, watchdogs, cleanup, endpoint feedback, retries, and portable-client integration.

name: Documentation
description: Project, backend, portable-client, and legacy integration guides document installation, operating procedures, protocol contracts, and dependency requirements for the distinct controller paths.

name: Configuration And Launchers
description: Example endpoint and APS settings plus Windows command launchers configure server/client deployment, start tray or console processes, and install backend dependencies.
